Add a criterion 4 test: pre-journal author_invoked for a pending message that has a recorded author verdict, run triage, then assert one decision-<id> record and zero requests with surface author.

Tighten the criterion 2 test. Assert exactly one new commit on main with subject chupa(<stem>): ticket, exactly one ticket_intake signal on the stem (a count, not any()), and the effect key llm/author/0/author/<seq>/1.
Build open_tickets as '<stem>: <first line of ## Goal / Why>' for each tracked tickets/<stem>/ticket.md, skipping merged stems by journal or ticket state. Do not send raw paths.

Remove the bare except around go_binds/baseline_identity. Call go_binds(events, baseline_identity(config, specs_dir)) directly. Before reporting ok, check every acceptance criterion against a named test.
